description.en-US:
NJ's personal app for the commitments in his own to-do sheet: each with
one next action, its day and how often it slipped. One tap marks a
next action done, "Ask Claude" sends a commitment to the Claude app, and a
spark (an idea for later) takes two seconds from the app, the widget or the
share sheet. The app needs a setup code to connect, so it does nothing useful
for anyone else.
